name: الرقم الوطني (national ID number)
issuer: the Civil Status Authority (مصلحة الأحوال المدنية), with the National ID project
note: Law No. 8 of 2014 on the national number (the General National Congress, 23 March 2014; its Arabic text as DCAF's Libya security-legislation database holds it, with DCAF's English translation, read 2026-10-30): the national number is one unique number for each citizen of twelve digits, from left to right: the first 1 for a man and 2 for a woman, the second to fifth the year of birth, the sixth to eleventh the citizen's number within that year and sex, the twelfth a check digit (art. 2; its rule isn't given, so `check` is left out); it is granted from birth on the person's data in the Civil Registry, provided the person is a Libyan citizen (art. 4); state bodies must use it to pay all salaries and remuneration and must suspend the pay of a citizen who doesn't give it (art. 7), read as needed for pay; temporary numbers are forbidden (art. 8). The pattern holds the sex digit, a year from 19 or 20 and the rest as digits. Read as given at birth, to citizens; foreign residents aren't given one by this law. No fee or time is stated.

sources.title: قانون رقم (8) لسنة 2014 م بشأن الرقم الوطني (DCAF Libya security-legislation database, Arabic text)
sources.said: الرقم الوطني هو رقم وحيد غير مكرر لكل مواطن يتكون من 12 خانة (اثنتي عشرة خانة). ... الخانة رقم (1) (الخانة الأولى) لتحديد (ذكر أو أنثى) بحيث يكون الرقم واحد (1) يدل على الذكر والرقم اثنين (2) يدل على الأنثى. ... الخانة رقم 12 (الخانة الثانية عشرة) تستخدم لفحص الرقم الوطني. ... يُمنح الرقم الوطني منذ الولادة بناء على بيانات الشخص في السجل المدني بمصلحة الأحوال المدنية ... وقف المرتب أو المكافأة أو الاستحقاق المالي لأي مواطن ليبي في حال عدم تقديمه للرقم الوطني المخصص له

sources.title: Law No. (8) of 2014 on the national ID number (DCAF's English translation)
sources.said: The national number shall be one unique number for each citizen made up of twelve (12) digits. ... The second, third, fourth, and fifth digits (digits 2, 3, 4, and 5) shall specify the citizen’s year of birth. ... Digits 6 to 11 shall specify the citizen’s number within the year of birth according to the category of male or female identified in the first digit (digit 1). ... National ID numbers shall be granted at birth, based on an individual’s data in the Civil Registry at the Civil Status Authority
